name: Winnebago Industries, Inc.
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. manufactures and sells outdoor lifestyle products primarily for use in leisure travel and outdoor recreation activities. It operates through three segments: Towable RV, Motorhome RV, and Marine. The company offers towable products that are non-motorized vehicles to be towed by automobiles, pickup trucks, SUVs, or vans for use as temporary living quarters, such as conventional travel trailers, fifth wheels, folding camper trailers, truck campers, and park models under the Winnebago and Grand Design brand names.
